ZWO Seestar S50

The all-in-one smart scope — it finds, tracks, and stacks for you.

around $500

A 50mm apochromatic smart telescope with built-in GoTo, plate solving, and live stacking, all controlled from your phone. Point it at the sky and watch deep-sky objects build up on screen — no eyepiece required.

Why we like it

  • Fully automated — plate solving finds targets itself
  • Live stacking shows deep-sky objects from light-polluted skies
  • Compact and genuinely portable

Keep in mind

  • Tiny 50mm aperture limits fine detail
  • Needs a charged battery and your phone/tablet
  • Screen observing isn't the same as eyepiece observing

Specs

Aperture50 mm (triplet apochromatic)
Focal length250 mm (f/5)
SensorSony IMX462 (2.06 MP)
ControliOS / Android app
PowerBuilt-in rechargeable battery
